subject.title: fix(android): release screenshots stall on gateway scene

question: Should the screenshot repair merge together with the frozen Android 2026.7.2 version, changelog, and Play release-note metadata carried by this branch?
rationale: Repository policy requires explicit approval for version and release metadata changes, and the strongest real behavior proof is bound to the combined candidate head.

options.title: Merge the refreshed candidate
options.body: Refresh the branch and required checks, then merge the combined fix and 2026.7.2 metadata if the frozen candidate is still current.

options.title: Split and re-prove the fix
options.body: Remove or separate the release metadata, then rerun the emulator screenshot and release-lane proof against the new exact head.

options.title: Pause this candidate
options.body: Keep the PR open without landing if Android 2026.7.2 release contents or timing have changed.

recommendation.title: Merge the refreshed candidate
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch and required checks, then merge the combined fix and 2026.7.2 metadata if the frozen candidate is still current.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked gateway-scene request and release-oriented maintainer context make this the strongest available owner for the release-inclusion choice.
